caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted object featuring a central eagle with widespread wings, colored primarily in shades of tan and light brown. The eagle's beak is open and its feathers are detailed with visible line patterns. Surrounding the eagle are symmetrical, ornate scroll-like motifs in a reddish-brown hue, positioned at the bottom left and right sides. There are two circular, hollowed shapes—one on each side of the eagle—framed by dark brown, leafy forms extending outward and downward from beneath the eagle’s wings. The entire object is centered on a plain light background.
title: Hose Holder
